issue.title: Retire period [!agent] instruction callouts in favor of brief-carried instructions

task_type_fields.proposal:
Retire the folded `> [!agent]- Agent instructions · weekly|quarterly|yearly v3` callouts in week, quarter, and year period notes. Since bob-cli-nh.3 (a29a64f6), every `bob periods brief <id>` prints its versioned instructions first (brief v3, Markdown and JSON), and the vault day.md / AGENTS.md pointers tell agents to run `bob periods brief`, so the callouts are a second, drift-prone copy of the same text that also has to be refreshed with `bob periods ensure -R`.

Proposed scope: stop emitting the callout from period scaffolds (`src/native/periods/instructions.rs` and the scaffold goldens), add a dry-run-first `bob periods migrate` (or `ensure`) step that strips existing callouts in one vault_rewrite, decide whether `ensure -R/--refresh-instructions` is retired or kept as a no-op alias, keep the readers that treat the callout as the end of period sections tolerant of notes that still carry it, and update docs/periods.md (callout section, brief section) plus the CLI reference via `just docs-gen`.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: plan:202611/period_intentions.md explicitly lists "Retiring the period callouts and the legacy fallback" as Out of scope and asks the adopt phase to record it as a follow-up; bob-cli-nh only moved the callouts to v3. Proposed by bob-cli-nh.8 note #3; triaged by the bob-cli-nh land agent.

issue.creation_reason: bob periods brief now carries the instructions itself, so the period-note callouts are a redundant second copy that bob-cli-nh's plan deferred retiring.
